about:
AG Parts Mfg Inc operates from Shelley, Idaho, where it has served the agricultural sector since at least 2010. The company does not publicly disclose its founders or ownership structure, but it presents itself as a dedicated supplier of replacement parts for farming equipment.

The business stocks and distributes a wide range of agricultural components — carrier rollers, flanged rollers, scrapers, shaker rollers, sprockets, standoffs, nose rollers, Flory sweepers, idlers, bushings, and bearings — with 145 active part numbers listed in its online catalog. Beyond distribution, AG Parts offers contract manufacturing services, stating it can find, design, or build custom parts for customers. The company warrants every sintered steel part it sells for one full year.

Primary customers include agricultural equipment dealers across the United States and individual growers who order directly. The company ships worldwide, positioning itself as a single source for both standard and hard-to-find components used in planting, harvesting, and soil-preparation machinery.

AG Parts emphasizes its "QUALITY in Motion" philosophy, highlighting an unconditional one-year warranty on sintered steel parts and a willingness to engineer custom solutions when off-the-shelf items do not meet a grower's needs.
